about:
# Hello Gamers!

This mod turns Geometry dash into Geometry Dash Lite, purely cosmetic, doesn't actually restrict you from any Full Version features. (keep in mind that this is based on the older version of geometry dash lite.)
changelog:
# 1.3.3
- iOS support back again!

# 1.3.2
- 2.2074 support
- removed herobrine
- mac support

# 1.3.0
- 2.206 support
- fixed issue where the "lite" text appears on the loading screen regardless whether its disabled or not
- added herobrine

# 1.2.2
- ios support

# 1.2.1
- Change GDLite watermark position
- Removed "Hide GDLite watermark" option. can be hiden by setting GDLite watermark position to 0.

# 1.2.0
- Ability to remove More games menu modification (to fix compatibility with other mods)
- Android32 support

# 1.1.0
- Ability to hide the "lite" subtext.
- Ability to remove the "GDLite. Free Trial" watermark from PlayLayer
- Android64 support

# 1.0.0
- Inital Release
